title: [CHORE] Establish GitHub CI/CD Pipeline and Repository Governance Templates
body:
Establish automated GitHub Actions CI pipeline covering linting, type-checking, automated unit testing, and build validation across all Turborepo workspaces.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Continuous Integration workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml` installed.
- Standardized issue templates and pull request templates configured.
- Repository governance documents (`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `SECURITY.md`) published.

title: [DOCS] Standardize README.md and Technical Documentation in Formal English
body:
Rewrite root documentation in professional, technical English adhering strictly to software engineering standards with zero unicode emojis.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Complete English overhaul of `README.md`.
- Architecture diagrams and technology stack tables standardized.
- Verification and setup commands documented.

title: [UI/BRAND] Replace Legacy Discord Icons with White Bravemath Brand Assets
body:
Replace legacy Discord SVG graphics across the web client with pure white Bravemath brand assets.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Replace Discord SVG in `HomeRailItem.tsx` with white Bravemath icon.
- Update application header, loading states, and metadata with official Bravemath branding.
- Maintain Ocean Swiss Minimalist design integrity.

title: [INFRA] Integrate Self-Hosted MinIO S3 Storage Alongside Cloudflare R2
body:
Integrate MinIO as a local/private S3-compatible object store in `docker-compose.yml` to allow zero-dependency local runs and on-premise deployments.

### Acceptance Criteria
- MinIO container and bucket initialization service added to `docker-compose.yml`.
- `StorageService` in `apps/api` upgraded to support path-style S3 endpoints.
- Environment variables documented in `.env.example`.

title: [FEATURE] Implement Large File & Multimedia Upload Pipeline with Progress Tracking
body:
Implement high-throughput file upload pipeline supporting images, audio, video, and documents with client-side progress bars and presigned URLs.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Upload route supporting up to 500MB with streaming validation.
- Client-side upload progress indicator in chat input.
- Staging attachment preview tray before message dispatch.

title: [FEATURE] Enable Multimedia Attachments in Direct Messages and Rich Media Previews
body:
Enable attachment dispatch and rendering in Direct Message channels, matching server channel capabilities with rich audio/video/document viewers.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Unblock `handleFiles` for DM contexts in `ChatView.tsx`.
- Render image lightboxes, inline audio players, and document download cards.
- Database attachment mapping validated.

title: [SECURITY] Implement TOTP Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) and Backup Codes
body:
Implement RFC 6238 Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) two-factor authentication with QR code pairing and recovery backup codes.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Prisma schema migration for `twoFactorEnabled`, `twoFactorSecret`, and backup codes.
- Endpoints for 2FA setup, verification, and challenge during login.
- UI workflow in user security settings.

title: [SECURITY] Active Device & Session Management via RefreshToken Tracking
body:
Provide visibility into active user sessions and devices with remote revocation capabilities.

### Acceptance Criteria
- API endpoint `GET /api/auth/sessions` listing active sessions with IP and user-agent metadata.
- Remote session revocation via `DELETE /api/auth/sessions/:id`.
- Active session list displayed in Settings > Account.

title: [FEATURE] User Protection, Privacy Controls, and Spam Reporting
body:
Provide comprehensive privacy controls including DM permissions, blocked user management, and spam report triggers.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Privacy settings toggles for direct messaging permissions.
- User blocking and unblocking management view.
- Report spam action button in direct messages.

title: [UI/UX] Redesign Multi-Layered User Settings Center and Quick Profile Popover
body:
Develop a Discord-grade multi-category settings center and interactive quick profile popover styled in Ocean Swiss Minimalist aesthetic.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Quick profile popover triggered from bottom dock.
- Full modal settings center with search bar and categorized navigation.
- Right sidebar member profile panel in Direct Messages.

title: [FEATURE] Multi-Language System (Vietnamese / English) and Appearance Preferences
body:
Implement dynamic language switching (Vietnamese / English) and display density preferences saved to user profile and local storage.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Type-safe i18n translation dictionary.
- Language selector in settings updating UI instantly.
- Message display density options (Cozy / Compact).

title: [FEATURE] Brave Nitro Tier System and Upload Quota Enforcement
body:
Introduce Brave Nitro subscription tier system granting increased file upload quotas (up to 500MB), animated avatars, and profile badges.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Tier definition and quota validation in API upload layer.
- Nitro marketing and management tab in User Settings.
- Visual badges displayed on user cards and message author tags.
